profile.headline: Software Engineer

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Reduced the build time by 55% by enabling incremental compilation, dependency caching, and parallelization
- Released three user-facing features including copy protocols and empty bates prefix upload support for attorneys and law firms

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Undergraduate researcher at Computational Photography Lab supervised by Professor Cossairt, Professor Willomitzer, and Ph.D. Matsuda from FRL
- Worked on DL-based eye tracking research for AR/VR headsets sponsored by Facebook Reality Labs

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Undergraduate researcher at Programming Languages Team supervised by Professor Dimoulas 
- Led a research project on designing a scalable, representative experiment for empirically validating the pragmatic value of contracts in facilitating the debugging process
- Wrote a mutation testing library in Racket using macros and LOP (Language-Oriented Programming)

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern at Augmented Reality Lab
positions.description:
- Built an end-to-end single image depth estimation and plane detection framework as part of a major research direction of transitioning from multi-view to single-view 
- Applied and analyzed the performance of state-of-the-art models from recent CVPR papers on in-house AR glass dataset

positions.title: Sergeant / Squad Leader / Interpreter
positions.description:
- Served as a leading interpreter for ROK-US combined exercises and instructed over 40 newly joined interpreters
- Completed Special Forces Qualification training and Airborne training in June 2018
- Received best soldier award for outstanding performance during Cold Weather Training

positions.title: Machine Learning Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Developed and deployed score prediction APIs that serve over 1+ million users for Santa TOEIC, an English Test Prep App in Korea, by using AWS Lambda and SNS, ReactiveX/RxJS, JavaScript, and Python
- Increased user test scores by 10% on average per every 50 questions solved by redesigning the question recommendation model from an expert tagging-based model to a probabilistic learning efficiency optimization one

positions.title: Undergraduate Researcher
positions.description:
- Undergraduate researcher at Bioinformatics lab supervised by Professor Jaehyuk Choi (http://choilaboratory.org/)
- Developed a framework for analyzing terabyte-scale DNA data and visualizing statistically significant mutations
- Reduced lab data storage by 12 terabytes and saved $3,000 quarterly by writing Python/bash scripts that automate the removal of duplicate files by md5sum comparisons
- Research abstract “Genomic Analysis of 220 CTCLs Identifies a Novel Recurrent Gain-of-function Alteration in RLTPR” published in NCBI: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28694326

company.name: Northwestern University, Feinberg School of Medicine

positions.title: Research Assistant at Laboratory for Computational Neurodiagnostics
positions.description:
Led the research project on the Computational Analysis of Visual and Linguistic Stimuli to predict Social Dominance

Designed various mathematical models and information-theoretic approaches to quantify the entropy of visual and linguistic cues that indicate behavioral dispositions

Implemented eye pupil movement and face shift tracking software in OpenCV to calculate Shannon entropy

educations.fieldOfStudy: Philosophy, English literature, European History, Chemistry
